tobacco_skip_rule.interpretation: Confirmed 100% adherence to CDC questionnaire routing logic. NaNs in SMOKDAY2 are NOT random missing values, but valid non-smoker skips.

lung_cancer_screening_routing.target_population: Adults aged 50-80 with significant tobacco smoking history
lung_cancer_screening_routing.interpretation: Variables in Section 13 are structurally blank for non-smokers and age groups outside screening guidelines.

cancer_survivorship_routing.interpretation: Administered only in states adopting Module 9 and only to self-reported cancer survivors. High structural non-response (94.9%) reflects state non-adoption and non-cancer status.
